_comment: Hand corrections for scripts/sync-index-data.js. Build input, not a deployed asset. Everything here is optional and sparse — only list a course when the git-derived date is wrong.
_ignoreCommits: SHAs to skip when looking for the last meaningful update. Empty on purpose: the CHURN_MIN=10 threshold already ignores the 7b6d63b framework codemod, which touched 32 courses with 2 lines each. Note 7b6d63b DID add real quiz content to 3 courses (genai-state-of-art, pe-playbook-tech, loop-engineering) at 173-211 lines, so blanket-ignoring it would lose a genuine update. Add a SHA here only if some future bulk edit crosses 10 lines per file.
_courses: Per-file overrides, each may set "added" and/or "updated" as YYYY-MM-DD. Use "note" to say why.

ai-hipaa-engineering-org-course.html.note: Authored and verified 31 Aug 2026; file mtime lands later than the authoring date, and the course body is dated 31 Aug 2026 throughout.
